lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's just under one? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's just under 1? Nope!

lines.text: Multiply these four brackets. What do you get?
lines.caption: Multiply these 4 brackets. What do you get?

lines.text: Each bottom number is the one before it, squared.
lines.caption: Each bottom number is the one before it, squared.

lines.text: Bring in a helper: one minus one over two.
lines.caption: Bring in a helper: 1 − 1/2.

lines.text: Multiply by the first bracket: one minus one over four.
lines.caption: Multiply by the first bracket: 1 − 1/4.

lines.text: Then one minus one over sixteen. Then one minus one over two hundred fifty-six.
lines.caption: Then 1 − 1/16. Then 1 − 1/256.

lines.text: Finally, one minus one over two hundred fifty-six squared. The chain collapses!
lines.caption: Finally, 1 − 1/256². The chain collapses!

lines.text: Undo the helper: double it. That's choice C!
lines.caption: Undo the helper: double it. That's choice C!

lines.text: Just under one was the trap. It forgets to undo the helper.
lines.caption: Just under 1 was the trap. It forgets to undo the helper.

lines.text: Did you get C? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get C? Tell me below!
